title.narrative: Just Rural Transition in Colombia

description.narrative: For this call for proposals, the Terms of Reference prioritized four intervention areas:1. Consolidate best agroecology and agroforestry practices for productive land reconversion and restoration with a sustainable market approach.2. Develop effective traceability systems for no deforestation and land degradation in existing value chains under zero-deforestation agreements and non-timber forest products (NTFPs).3. Enable more applied research and bioeconomy products development for sustainable production, use, commercialisation, and conservation of biological resources.4. Improve the design and implementation of financial instruments for rural nature-based solutions, involving local communities.The GGGI Colombia team plans to tackle the areas of intervention 3 and 4. Area of Intervention 3 based on the previous Bioeconomy UKPACT project considering a scale-up of the Bioeconomy Projects Acceleration Mechanism - MAPBIO with investment commitments and impact measuring; a comprehensive set of private sector bioeconomy innovation challenges which includes commitments from enterprises to implement the solutions designed; an interinstitutional bioeconomy taskforce with the three ministries involved so far (Sciences, Environment, and Commerce), and including the National Planning Department and prioritized territorial entities.The team is also planning for this new call for proposals, the design of financial mechanisms for fostering the bioeconomy within the country considering all the complexities and opportunities and involving public and private financial institutions. Likewise, a knowledge exchange program will be designed to strengthen the capacities of the bioeconomy enterprises in commercial phase operation, investment, and alliances, among others.
